title: Choose the visual world
question: Bolder hand: the deal put Emission Line Rail first. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.lineage: Glass spectrograms on a viewing box: a charcoal continuum crossed by needle-thin bright lines
options.thesis: Radio as spectrum: every Station is a line on one tuning rail, and state is told by line form, not colour.
materials: one grotesque, ranked by tracking and ink
options.viewport: Player screen: an off-centre tuning rail runs the window's height with every Station as a tick in its genre's line colour; the playing one stands full height and blooms into a large plate (art, name, transport, history). The Visualizer draws as emission lines; reconnecting shows dashed, liked tracks doubled in sodium yellow.
options.case: Leads by deal order: a radio dial is a rail of frequencies, and the Visualizer is literally a spectrum.
options.risk: Line-form state (dashed, half-height, doubled) is abstract; every state also needs a plain word beside it.

raised.raise: Acetate manual: each genre owns one emission hue at full strength, used identically on the rail, Grid, Liked and bar.
Bitmap specimen: type is locked to three integer size steps; hierarchy comes from tracking and ink, never extra sizes.
Gate board: rows keep identity; a new track slides the history down in place and its line stays lit until seen.

options.label: Catalogue Sleeve
options.lineage: Factory Records' catalogue identity: matte black, white pulse plots, numbered everything
options.thesis: Every Station is a catalogue entry; the live spectrum draws itself as a stacked pulse plot.
options.viewport: Player screen: vast black field owned by a live ridgeline plot of the stream's spectrum (stacked white lines), the Station's catalogue number as the headline, name and transport small and exact; history as a numbered index. Names stay readable: clarity beats code.
options.case: Beats the leader on both axes: music listeners know this language by heart, and a plain catalogue index reads faster than a rail.
options.risk: Unknown Pleasures is the most quoted sleeve in history; it must be live data, never a print of it.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.lineage: Celestial atlases read under a red flashlight
options.thesis: SomaFM's sky: Stations plotted as stars, listener count as magnitude, the playing one ringed in night-vision red.
options.viewport: Grid as a chart-like index: each Station a row or tile with a magnitude dot sized by listeners; Player screen ringed in red; the Visualizer drifts slowly like sidereal motion.
options.case: Holds audience identification (Deep Space One, Drone Zone, Mission Control); weaker on clarity, since a sky map is slower to scan than a list.
options.risk: Space-theme cliché unless the magnitude ramp does real work.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Genres as full-hue divider boards under acetate leaves.
options.viewport: Stepped genre tabs down the edge, content on translucent leaves.
options.case: Listeners do not know software manuals; milk acetate fights the pinned dark-only theme.
options.risk: Reads as a manual, not a player.
options.kept: One full-strength hue per genre, used identically everywhere.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.viewport: Huge pixel Station names over dense columns.
options.case: Light newsprint ground breaks dark-only; bitmap type fails at a glance in a small window.
options.kept: Type locked to a few integer size steps.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: Boarding passes and live departure boards
options.thesis: History as a departures board that reranks in place.
options.viewport: Stations as departures, the Now playing as a pass.
options.case: Travel metaphors confuse a radio player; listeners don't identify with airports.
options.kept: Rows keep identity and stay lit until seen.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A desktop music player as the big streaming apps ship it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Side nav, art-led Grid, Player with big art and transport, persistent bottom bar.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other player by design, close to today's look.
